t: Chance Decoding Engines: RNG Test Battery — Simple
name: Chance Decoding Engines: RNG Test Battery — Simple
title: Chance Decoding Engines: RNG Test Battery — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A battery that tests random number generators honestly: frequency, runs, serial correlation, and entropy estimation, each with a pass threshold and a sample-size requirement. A generator passes the battery or it doesn't ship.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Test-outcome entropy at p=0.5 = 1.0000 bits. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
